svg.title: Customer purchase paths after Bike
svg.desc: 389 recorded second purchases radiate from the center toward seven original product icons. These are the workbook’s saved scatter coordinates, not newly generated points. The 316 customers without a second purchase are omitted, as in the original chart.
svg.metadata: Markov Chain chart28: Y4:Z2002; saved Bike view. X axis -11 to 13; Y axis -11 to 14; axes hidden. Original workbook icons and drawing transforms retained.
